description.narrative: African entreprenuers based in Africa and whose products/services serve an African market and are managed by youth between the ages of 18-35 years. The investment sought should be between USD 0.25 million to USD 10 million for a majority or minotiry stake, and structured as equity, debt or a hybrid transaction.

The Jobs for Youth in Africa (JfYA) strategy adopted by AfDB to equip young people to realize their potential and spur inclusive economic growth through increasing inclusive employment, creating jobs and entreprenuership, strengthening human capital and creating durable labour market linkages. The project supports training, mentoring, access to networks and funding for business development of youth led start-ups and MSMEs among the youth. The project implemented the Africa Investment Forum 2019 for the youth entreprenuerial ventures to connect with investors, mentorship and entreprenuership ecosystem partners.

To feature and match high growth potential ventures/MSMEs with investors in order to bridge the investment gap for businesses with high job creation potential for the youth in priority sectors of agriculture, industry, energy and ICT.
